import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs/promises';import os from 'node:os';import path from 'node:path';import{readGroupRss}from'./watchdog.mjs';
test('matched owned task then malformed reread stat must not disappear from measurement',async()=>{const p=await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'rss-independent-'));await fs.mkdir(p+'/1');await fs.writeFile(p+'/1/stat','1 (node) R 0 123 0');await fs.writeFile(p+'/1/status','State:\tR (running)\n');const original=fs.readFile;let statReads=0,mutated=false;try{fs.readFile=async(f,...a)=>{if(String(f)===p+'/1/stat'&&++statReads===2){mutated=true;return '1 (node) R';}return original(f,...a);};let error,result;try{result=await readGroupRss(123,p);}catch(e){error=e;}assert.equal(mutated,true);assert.ok(error,'malformed owned-task stat silently omitted: '+JSON.stringify(result));assert.match(error.message,/proc_stat_invalid|proc_rss_missing/);}finally{fs.readFile=original;await fs.rm(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}});
